lignes.note: Councillor Kerry Jang received retroactive payment of $11,975 paid out in 2013 for Transportation Allowance for the period from 2008 to 2012 as noted in the 2012 Council Remuneration and Expenses report at Council on March 12, 2013. See http://council.vancouver.ca/20130312/documents/a2.pdf

In addition to the Travel and Training Expenses, the following Councillors incurred additional travel expenses funded by a City department as noted in the 2015 Council Remuneration and Expenses report at Council on February 24, 2016: $1,448 for Councillor Kerry Jang and $4,907 for Councillor Andrea Reimer. See http://council.vancouver.ca/20160224/documents/pspc2.pdf

With the enactment of By-laws No. 11483 and No. 11529 in mid-2016 and in response to the Council approved motion of Proactive Quarterly Release of Mayor's Office Expenses on May 3, 2016, a budget review was completed which resulted in a new reporting style of Mayor and Council expenses and inclusion of office budgets.
The budget allocation was adjusted due to the resignation of Councillor Geoff Meggs (July 4, 2017) and the election of Councillor Hector Bremner (October 31, 2017).
